Require dated ownership, root cause, isolated validation, rollback, deduplication, release, security, attribution, and measurement evidence before any dispatch or requeue. Preserve current private launch gates and parked dispositions. Continue only the existing finance reconciliation and bounded legal/security evidence work; keep external permission outreach unsent pending human-counsel review and owner authorization.

Any future adoption requires a disposable prototype, security and license review, owner-approved implementation, isolated validation, rollback, and an existing measurable outcome.

Do not infer site revenue, margin, ROI, payback, budget capacity, cost-to-learn, or causal lift from clicks, orders, shipped items, sessions, conversions, AI usage, or output counts.

Continue the existing bounded read-only security evidence matrix using authorized metadata and retained artifacts only. Preserve private launch gates and block security-sensitive releases until evidence is complete. Do not access credentials or private containers, change permissions or configuration, add dependencies, deploy, exploit targets, or conduct external outreach.
